channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dusty May | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dusty May from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Morez Johnson Jr. on Dusty May
item.description:
Michigan forward Morez Johnson Jr. on what Dusty May brings to the Mavs (via ESPN):

“He brings consistency. He's going to show up and be the same guy everyday. He's gonna set the standard, but he's also going to follow the standard as well. He's not just gonna say something & do the opposite. He's a great guy. He wants to put his players in the right positions to do well.”

Morez Johnson Jr. on Dusty May, Jun 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg on Dusty May
item.description:
Michigan forward Yaxel Lendeborg on what Dusty May brings to the Mavs (via ESPN):

“He's a guy who really cares for your well-being, not just what you can do for him on the court. He puts away all that stuff aside and steps in like a father-figure role and really cares.”

Yaxel Lendeborg on Dusty May, Jun 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg on Dusty May
item.description:
Yaxel Lendeborg on Dusty May's hiring and potential reunion:

“I'm going to tell him he better pick me up. If he doesn't, I'm going to be mad, I might block him. But it would be amazing being able to stick with him.”

Yaxel Lendeborg on Dusty May, Jun 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Dusty May
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Mark Cuban on the Mavericks' hiring of Michigan coach Dusty May:

“He is an Indiana grad. I met him way back when he worked as a student manager and video coach. I'm sure he will do a great job.”

Mark Cuban on Dusty May, Jun 22, 2026. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.
